description: Lightkeeper for Codex: the same hook scripts Claude Code runs, through codex/adapter.py.

hooks.command: command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && python3 "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/codex/adapter.py" session_start || cat >/dev/null; exit 0
command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && python3 "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/codex/adapter.py" prompt_hint || cat >/dev/null; exit 0
command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && python3 "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/codex/adapter.py" file_guard || cat >/dev/null; exit 0
command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && python3 "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/codex/adapter.py" stop_reminder || cat >/dev/null; exit 0
